## GrowAssistant – Crop Steering v0.1.9

This bugfix release resets cycle state reliably at the start of every new LED light cycle.

### Automatic grow-day reset

- Runs exactly once per grow day at LED sunrise, including overnight cycles such as 19:00–07:00.
- Clears P1 Active, P1 Done, P1 Window Opened Today, P1 Shots Done, P2 Shots Done, and P2 Reference VWC.
- Preserves Last Shot and does not control or activate pumps.
- Persists a cycle marker to prevent duplicate resets after Home Assistant restarts.
- Catches up once when Home Assistant starts during an active light cycle and that grow day has not yet been reset.
- Ignores sunrise or sunset helper changes for the current active cycle, preventing a second reset; the new sunrise is used for the next grow day.
